extension.summary: Πρόσθετο MEGA Player για το Kodi
extension.description: Ζωντανές και on demand υπηρεσίες του MEGA
extension.disclaimer: This addon offers content available in Greece and is not published nor endorsed by megatv.com
Το πρόσθετο αυτό προσφέρει περιεχόμενο διαθέσιμο στην Ελλάδα και δεν έχει δημοσιευθεί ούτε εγκριθεί από το megatv.com
extension.news: [B]1.0.0[/B] - Initial version - Live (Vindral, resolved via ResolveURL / PluginsGR MegaTV resolver), TV shows by section, latest videos, Mega Kids, news and programme guide - Collections: Mega Classics and Archive tags, Season 2025-2026, Comedy/Drama playlists, Golden Classics videos and MegaNews hub - Episode listings cover every video flavor (ftv/fltv/ktvshows, megasports, goldenclassics) and walk the site's episode pagination for long shows, with concurrent page enrichment for faster loading - Search through the site's WordPress REST API (shows and episodes) - Shows with no published episodes (e.g. older classics like "Το Νησί") fall back to the show trailer - Video listings quote the parent show ("Show - Episode"), so date-titled entries are identifiable - Modernized stack: tulip 4.x, urldispatcher, netclient, unicache
